steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Don't move an inch. Do you have a death wish?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: It's hard to stand still with your paw pressing down on me! If we snap another thread, we'll all be turned into pincushions.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: I just blocked plenty of those darts for you, and you won't let me borrow your shoulder for support? Besides, if I really wanted to hurt you, I could've just shifted when that arrow came earlier. You'd be clutching your knee and crying now.
You're stuck in the middle of their endless bickering. This situation has been going on for a quarter of an hour since you all got caught in the traps.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You two better switch your positions now.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Why?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm about to get... leg cramps...
The two carefully move away, finally allowing your stiff leg to relax. You feel slightly more comfortable in your new position, but the predicament you face hasn't improved in the slightest.
You attempt to force your way through a few steps, but only end up triggering even more mechanisms.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hmm, these traps must have cost a fortune. Icesilk reinforced with darkiron core is invisible in sunlight. Plus a network of pressure plates buried underfoot. Quite a fancy game for those with a morbid taste!
Xiaofeng doesn't seem nervous at all. Instead, she can't resist reaching out to pluck at the silken threads dangling before her eyes.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: You seem awfully familiar with this. You didn't set up these traps, did you?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Why would the carefree Mountain Lord know so much about these elaborate, devious contraptions? You're looking rather suspicious here.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hey now, you're being unfair! I'm simply knowledgeable and like to learn about these intricate little things you humans invent. How about this? To prove my innocence, let me try to "unwind" this thing a bit.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Just a warning, my methods are a bit on the rough side. Don't blame me if I slip up and turn everyone into porcupines!
She leans in closer with a mischievous grin, only to be pushed away by Shuang'er with a look of disgust.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Hmph, do you think we can't get out without you? I'm the most promising future hero of Ping'an Town after all! Come on, young hero, it's time for us to show what we're made of.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Us? You have a plan?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: I may not know much about martial arts, but I know this saying: There's always a solution within three steps. Where all the thread patterns converge is the nexus of this system! Destroy it, and we can be free!

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Look, there's a groove at the top of that stele. That's got to be the key! But the threads are too dense along the way... I'll guide your movements.

You look to the left: Shuang'er, brimming with confidence but weighed down by a bag full of medicine bottles. Then to the right: Xiaofeng, grinning carelessly but not to be trusted to ensure your safety. You sigh, duck under a thread, and head in the direction Shuang'er indicated.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Move right three inches! Watch out for that horizontal thread.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: There's more than one horizontal thread here.

You gather up the hem of your Eastian robe and slowly crouch down, lifting your head to watch those nearly invisible threads pass mere inches from your forehead. After painstakingly moving just three inches forward, you're about to straighten up when you hear Shuang'er gasp.
A sharp snap comes from behind your head as a thread breaks. A bronze battle ax immediately crashes down from above, hitting the ground right beside your feet.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Whoa, thank you. Now things just got a whole lot harder.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: It's all this mangy tiger's fault for interrupting me! Listen, let me start over: Bend backward, go between these two threads, then lift your foot...
You attempt to bend backward and get stuck halfway.

Despite making no big movements, you've already broken out in a thin layer of sweat. When the cold wind hits, your entire body stiffens. But you still focus on the next obstacle ahead as Shuang'er directed, hugging your arms close to your body as you begin to slowly lean backward.
But you stop in the middle.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Did you just say to bend backward while lifting my foot at the same time? Is that... even humanly possible?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Listen to me instead! Move three steps to the right, then drop into a horse stance! I've done the math. From that distance, you can dodge four traps at once. Much more efficient.

You can't hold this position much longer anyway, so you close your eyes, steel yourself, and take a step as Xiaofeng suggested. Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh! Three crossbow bolts fly just over your head, slicing off a few strands of hair.
Fortunately, you were crouched in the horse stance, or those bolts would have gone straight through your head. From this point on, you don't dare make another careless move.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: You mangy tiger, you nearly got someone killed! You can clearly see that all the threads on the right are connected to an underground crossbow!

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hey, I'm thinking ten moves ahead. And no one got shot, alright? This time it'll be fine. Take another half step left, push aside those two threads...

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Don't touch them. That floor tile is slightly higher than the others. There might be another trap underneath that's sensitive to pressure.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Don't you trust the judgment of the great White Tiger Mountain Lord? I've never made a wrong move during all my travels all these years!

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: You just lost to us once today. Young hero, you should listen to me instead. I was the one who discovered the nexus. Trust my keen eyes.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: What good are keen eyes? Look at those skinny limbs. You're too scrawny to even be Meowy's snack. Aren't you embarrassed, shouting "I want to be a great hero!" in that squeaky little voice of yours all the time?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: I'm just not lucky enough to have been born with a stronger body! Otherwise, I would've long since become the famous founder of the Tiger-Beating Staff techniques!

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Oh no, you're cursed with bad luck too? All the more reason not to listen to your instructions!
The two of them argue endlessly. Without anyone giving directions, you actually find yourself calming down and focusing your attention on the thread patterns before you.

After all, Ma Ling laid these traps in haste. Though the threads crisscross in a bewildering tangle, the underlying principle is actually quite simple. You discover that the key lies in the hidden triggers at each thread's end. By watching whether the endpoints go taut as you move, you can anticipate danger.
Perhaps you can break through the patterns on your own.
You take a step forward tentatively.
The threads hang quietly. Nothing happens.
Another step. Still safe.
Having taken several steps without incident, you grow even bolder. Before long, you've already drawn close to the nexus Shuang'er pointed out earlier.

Feeling a rush of relief, you duck down again to avoid another thread in front of you. But the moment your weight settles, the green tile beneath your foot sinks, and a series of mechanical clicks echoes from all directions at once.

Several poisoned crossbow bolts streak toward you in rapid succession. As you dodge, your shoulders and sleeves brush against even more threads. One trigger sets off the next, and soon the entire corridor's traps are activated.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Don't move! The poisoned bolts are a decoy. The real threat is coming your way!

Almost instantly, a muffled mechanical roar echoes from the far end of the corridor as a white ash spear comes hurtling straight at you. You twist aside just in time, but the spear doesn't stop, flying toward Shuang'er, trapped helplessly in the web of threads!
Xiaofeng lunges forward to intercept it, but the threads limit her range, and her fingertips miss the spear's tail by mere inches.
You have no time to think. You scan your surroundings, push off on your toes, and hurl yourself directly into the thickest cluster of threads.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: No! There's a chain of mechanisms there! You'll...
The floor beside you bursts open, shooting out iron caltrops and tripwires. Though they can't bring down the spear entirely, they manage to knock it off course by several inches.

The spear tip grazes past Shuang'er's ribs and embeds itself in a corridor pillar. Shuang'er is safe. But where you landed, the tiles are sinking, and a cloud of purple poison gas erupts from the cracks, instantly filling your vision.

The gas carries a pungent, sickly-sweet fragrance that floods your nose and mouth. Your throat burns, then your limbs seize up before going limp as wet clay. You can't summon the slightest bit of strength.
Everything before your eyes begins to sway and blur. Shuang'er's panicked cries and the lingering mechanical noise quickly grow muffled and distant, dissolving into a low drone.
Just before your vision fades to black, a frigid voice cuts through the fog.
Hold your breath...
Clang!
[Insert CG] Skyfall Manor Lord
A white flash from a blade cleaves through the air, instantly dispersing the poison gas in its wake and severing the countless icesilk threads.
The hidden weapons triggered at the other end of those threads are also instantly struck down and shattered like rotten wood.
Through the swirling snow and lingering mist, a slender figure in white descends gracefully.

She stands against the light, straight-backed like a pine tree, the sword in her hand a hazy shadow. In your dazed state, you think you glimpse winter plum blossoms blooming from the blade's edge... Are you hallucinating from the poison?

steps.speaker: Frigid Voice
steps.content: Gather your breath in your abdomen and guard your heart. Try to keep the poison from rising.
Her silhouette, her voice, even the technique of that sword strike just now. Everything matches perfectly with the person behind the curtains at the banquet yesterday.
It's the master of Northsnow Manor, <color=#fb9259>Jichuan</color>.
